mercy_translation.text:
Concerning baptism, baptize in this way. Having first taught all these things, baptize in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit in living water.

If you do not have living water, baptize in other water. If you cannot use cold water, use warm. If you have neither, pour water three times upon the head in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit.

Before the baptism, let the one baptizing and the one being baptized fast, together with any others who are able. Instruct the one being baptized to fast for one or two days beforehand.

translator_notes: Direct Mercy translation from the Greek public-domain source.
'Living water' is rendered in its ordinary ancient sense of flowing/running water.
The text allows pouring three times on the head when immersion conditions are unavailable.
